deadline.value: Chemistry's PhD application deadline is December 1; the page gives no year, so 2026 is inferred for Fall 2027 entry.

gre_general.value: The department does not require or accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Our department does not require or accept GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require or accept GRE scores, including the subject test.
gre_subject.quote: Our department does not require or accept GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL or IELTS is required unless the applicant studied a year in an English-speaking country; the suggested TOEFL figure is on an unclear scale, so no minimum is recorded.

ielts_min.value: Chemistry suggests a minimum IELTS of 7, but reviews every application holistically.
ielts_min.quote: We suggest a minimum score of 5 (TOEFL) or 7 (IELTS), but we review every application holistically.

supervisor.value: Admission is by an admissions committee into a rotations programme; no advisor is needed beforehand.
supervisor.quote: there is no need to secure an advisor prior to admission

funding.value: All accepted chemistry PhD applicants get a $43,260 base stipend and a full tuition waiver.
funding.quote: All accepted applicants receive our generous base stipend.

entry_route.value: The page says an MS can be earned on the way to the PhD but does not say whether a bachelor's alone is enough.

notes: Chemistry's application runs through Laney. The Peterson's listing (GRE and January 3 deadline) is third-party and was not used. Apply-by Nov 15 link on the homepage is not explained on the apply page and was not used.
